I think this recording is REALLY interesting. IMHO, it's a bit shaky and unbalanced, and unlike many of their live offerings, I prefer the studio version. This shouldn't be too much of a surprise, since this Denmark Radio appearance was one of their earliest live shows, and I still enjoy the rawness of the song (one of it's virtues, whichever version).
